client_problem: Align measured 2D image points with known 3D landmarks for AR, capture, or inspection.
client_scenario: A client needs an AR overlay, capture rig, or inspection camera to line up projected 3D landmarks with measured 2D points.
paper_family_claim: Capture and display papers depend on projecting 3D structure into 2D views and minimizing alignment error.
related_siggraph_papers: EgoRelight: Egocentric Human Capture and Illumination Recovery for Relightable and Photoreal Avatar Rendering
Hi-SPAD: Video-Rate Hyperspectral Imaging and Inference with Single-Photon Cameras
Invisible Holographic Window: Full-color 3D Image Reconstruction from Transparent Surface-relief Computer-generated Holograms
demo_proves: Wrong camera parameters create visible reprojection error; optimizing them reduces alignment error.
